call_points.text: Sterling expects to cross 95 resorts and 4,500 rooms in 2027, with more than 20 sign-ups in the pipeline.
Travel segment 5% EBIT margin target maintained despite short-haul mix shift.
Sterling added 14 resorts last year and 14 the year before; occupancy improved to 64% despite higher supply.
Short-haul bookings grew 17% for the year and 21% in Q4; long-haul remains subdued.
MICE pipeline strong but corporates delaying decisions; management expects volumes to return in H2FY27.
Forex segment Q4 revenue rose 3% to ₹81.3 Cr and EBIT 17% to ₹39.2 Cr, with 48% EBIT margin.
Net cash is available; plans include technology capex, debt repayment and acquisitions.
DEI expects only 50-60% recovery in Middle East by year-end; cost cuts will take months.
Board recommended dividend of ₹0.50 per share, subject to shareholder approval.
Management remains cautiously optimistic given ongoing uncertainties, focusing on fiscal management and technology.

operating_notes.text: Prepaid forex card portfolio expanded to 28 currencies from 12, adding 16 currencies including Chinese Yuan, Vietnamese Dong and Gulf currencies.
Forex can be bought and loaded on prepaid cards in under an hour via the Blinkit partnership, with 24x7 WhatsApp assistance.
Signed long-term MoU with Vinpearl of Vietnam to secure preferred partnership terms and inventory.
Appellate Tribunal Under SAFEMA partially allowed the company's FEMA appeals, reducing aggregate penalties to ₹39.96 million from ₹61.6 million, excluding ₹12.3 million already deposited.
Sterling Holiday Resorts demerger proposed with a share swap ratio of 0.81 shares for every 1 TCIL share.
Sterling FY26: resort revenue ₹467.8 Cr (85% of total), room revenue up 21% YoY, F&B up 14%; Q4 room revenue ₹67.2 Cr, ARR ₹6,347, occupancy 64%.
Sterling operating free cash flow grew 49% YoY to ₹114 Cr in FY26, with cash reserves near ₹340 Cr and no debt.
Sterling added nearly 1.5 resorts a month in FY26 and 31 resorts over 24 months, reaching 78 resorts across 65+ destinations.
Sterling Q4FY26: occupancy 64%, ARR ₹6,347 (+12%), RevPAR +16% despite 20% more rooms.
Forex segment: retail contributes ~80% of reported revenue; digital penetration 23%; prepaid card float ~₹1,600 Cr.
DEI: Middle East is 50% of revenue; management estimates 50-60% recovery by end of FY27.
TCI Euro, the Cyprus (Nicosia) office set up in 2025, is TCIL's EU base for business travel of Indian corporates and multinational clients.
Sterling Holiday Resorts opened Sterling Leopard Haven Jawai featuring 19 cottages, suites and villas.
Sterling opened Sterling Vanyatara Tadoba, an 18-key wilderness retreat with access to five safari gates of the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, subject to permits.
Sterling's portfolio stands at more than 70 destinations and over 4,000 operational keys.

timeline.summary: Thomas Cook India and SOTC launched a unique visa rejection travel insurance cover underwritten by ICICI Lombard.
On 30 April 2026, Thomas Cook India expanded its prepaid forex card portfolio to 28 currencies with 16 additions, available on Visa and Mastercard cards.
Thomas Cook India scheduled its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call for May 13, 2026.
Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel signed a strategic MoU with Vietnam's Vinpearl to enhance offerings for Indian travellers.

On 11 May 2026, Thomas Cook India said the Appellate Tribunal Under SAFEMA at New Delhi partially allowed its FEMA appeals, cutting aggregate penalties to ₹39.96 million from ₹61.6 million, with no material financial impact stated.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,770.69 Cr (-10.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹38.66 Cr (-40.1% YoY).
On May 12, 2026, Thomas Cook India reported FY26 total income of ₹8,558 Cr, up 3% YoY, while Q4 FY26 PBT declined due to geopolitical disruptions.
On May 12, 2026, Thomas Cook India announced its 49th AGM date for September 10, 2026, and the upcoming retirement of Non-Executive Director Chandran Ratnaswami.
On May 12, 2026, Thomas Cook India released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation and announced the proposed demerger of Sterling Holiday Resorts.

On May 18, 2026, Thomas Cook India released the transcript of its May 13 Q4 & FY26 earnings call, where management said FY26 EBT fell 14% to ₹326.8 Cr on geopolitical disruption and the Sterling demerger is on track for Q1FY28.

On May 23, 2026, Thomas Cook India disclosed a May 22 GST order from the Commercial Tax Officer, Chennai Central, for ₹1,25,434 demand plus ₹1,14,932 interest and ₹1,25,434 penalty, saying there is no material impact.
On May 26, 2026, Thomas Cook India announced an exclusive partnership with Atlys to integrate forex into the visa application journey.

On June 1, 2026, Thomas Cook India said it would work with Eurobank, through its Cyprus subsidiary TCI Euro, to serve Indian enterprises operating or expanding in the European Union; no value was disclosed.
Sterling Holiday Resorts opened Sterling Leopard Haven Jawai in Rajasthan, expanding its wilderness portfolio and regional circuit.
2026-10-16: Sterling Holiday Resorts opened Sterling Vanyatara Tadoba, an 18-key wildlife retreat near the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra.
